name: create_php_csv_dedupe_latest
description: Builds a CSV importer that keeps the latest row per id by timestamp, consumed by an existing report
prompts: An existing src/DirectoryReport.php calls UserImporter::importLatest($csvText), but UserImporter does not exist yet. Create src/UserImporter.php defining namespace App, class UserImporter, and a static method importLatest(string $csvText): array that parses CSV text with the header row `id,name,updated_at` and returns an associative array mapping each id (string) to the name (string) from that id's most recent row - the row with the greatest integer updated_at. If the same id appears twice with the same updated_at, the row that comes later in the file wins. Skip any row whose id is empty/whitespace or whose updated_at is missing or not an integer. Input with only a header (or no valid rows) returns an empty array. Do not modify DirectoryReport.php.

setup_files.src/DirectoryReport.php:
<?php
namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/UserImporter.php';

class DirectoryReport
{
    // Render the latest name per id, one line per id, sorted by id.
    public static function render(string $csvText): string
    {
        $latest = UserImporter::importLatest($csvText);
        ksort($latest);
        $lines = [];
        foreach ($latest as $id => $name) {
            $lines[] = "$id: $name";
        }
        return implode("\n", $lines);
    }
}

<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/DirectoryReport.php';

final class UserImporterTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testKeepsLatestByTimestamp(): void
    {
        $csv = "id,name,updated_at\n1,Alice,100\n2,Bob,50\n1,Alicia,200\n";
        $this->assertSame(['1' => 'Alicia', '2' => 'Bob'], \App\UserImporter::importLatest($csv));
    }

    public function testLaterRowWinsOnTie(): void
    {
        $csv = "id,name,updated_at\n7,First,500\n7,Second,500\n";
        $this->assertSame(['7' => 'Second'], \App\UserImporter::importLatest($csv));
    }

    public function testSkipsInvalidRows(): void
    {
        $csv = "id,name,updated_at\n" .
            "1,Keep,100\n" .
            ",Blank,200\n" .
            "   ,Space,300\n" .
            "9,NoTime,\n" .
            "9,BadTime,notanumber\n";
        $this->assertSame(['1' => 'Keep'], \App\UserImporter::importLatest($csv));
    }

    public function testHeaderOnlyIsEmpty(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], \App\UserImporter::importLatest("id,name,updated_at\n"));
    }

    public function testIntegratesWithReport(): void
    {
        $csv = "id,name,updated_at\n1,Alice,100\n1,Alicia,200\n2,Bob,50\n";
        $this->assertSame("1: Alicia\n2: Bob", \App\DirectoryReport::render($csv));
    }
}

reference_solution.src/UserImporter.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class UserImporter
{
    // Keep the latest name per id by integer updated_at; later row wins ties.
    public static function importLatest(string $csvText): array
    {
        $lines = preg_split('/\r\n|\r|\n/', trim($csvText));
        if (count($lines) <= 1) {
            return [];
        }
        array_shift($lines); // drop header

        $latest = [];   // id => name
        $bestTs = [];   // id => updated_at
        foreach ($lines as $line) {
            if ($line === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $cols = str_getcsv($line);
            $id = trim((string) ($cols[0] ?? ''));
            $name = (string) ($cols[1] ?? '');
            $rawTs = trim((string) ($cols[2] ?? ''));
            if ($id === '' || $rawTs === '' || !ctype_digit($rawTs)) {
                continue;
            }
            $ts = (int) $rawTs;
            if (!isset($bestTs[$id]) || $ts >= $bestTs[$id]) {
                $bestTs[$id] = $ts;
                $latest[$id] = $name;
            }
        }
        return $latest;
    }
}

<?php
namespace App;

class UserImporter
{
    // BUG: does not skip blank ids or non-integer timestamps; (int) casts
    // 'notanumber' to 0 and blank ids leak in as ''.
    public static function importLatest(string $csvText): array
    {
        $lines = preg_split('/\r\n|\r|\n/', trim($csvText));
        if (count($lines) <= 1) {
            return [];
        }
        array_shift($lines);
        $latest = [];
        $bestTs = [];
        foreach ($lines as $line) {
            if ($line === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $cols = str_getcsv($line);
            $id = trim((string) ($cols[0] ?? ''));
            $name = (string) ($cols[1] ?? '');
            $ts = (int) ($cols[2] ?? 0);
            if (!isset($bestTs[$id]) || $ts >= $bestTs[$id]) {
                $bestTs[$id] = $ts;
                $latest[$id] = $name;
            }
        }
        return $latest;
    }
}
